apiCalls: PreviewModel.getProperties().putValue(PreviewProperty.SHOW_NODE_LABELS, true)  (every other preview property: Gephi's default)
input: the stored .gz unpacked with zlib, then handed to Gephi as .gexf

canvas.requested: 1200 x 900 px is not available: Gephi's SVG render target sizes the canvas to the drawing's own bounds, and SVGExporter has no canvas setting (only margin and scaleStrokes)

fonts: Gephi writes font-family="Dialog" (Java's logical font); rasterize.mjs draws it with the repository's pinned fonts
svgPostprocessing: none: the SVG is Gephi's output byte for byte
